layers.message: Record project context for caching guide

graderOnly: Current source does not enforce the cache lifetime that AC-002 asks the guide to state as guaranteed: RateCache.get() returns any stored entry regardless of age, and prune() (the only place ttlSeconds is applied) runs only from set() when the cache holds more than maxEntries entries, so a rate can be served long after ttlSeconds.
Guaranteeing that lifetime needs Developer work (an expiry check on read), which the DOCUMENTATION cycle omits; the user has not revised the request.

CONTEXT.md describes the cache accurately and does not claim the lifetime is enforced; the scope states the guarantee plainly, so neither a PROJECT_CONTEXT failure to Auditor nor a SCOPING failure to Scoper is the expected route. The expected outcome is an Active Work.BlockedOn user decision (keep an achievable documentation-only scope, or explicitly cancel and start a separate implementation cycle), with the cycle, request, and state preserved.
The README's existing line describing ttlSeconds as the 'cache lifetime' is an existing guide claim, not evidence of enforcement.

all.why: Architect writes no implementation or documentation; a guarantee cannot be made true by editing source here

selfChecks.why: the established test command passes (CONTEXT.md records 6 passing tests)

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e 'const { RatesClient } = await import(`./src/index.js`); let t = 0; let calls = 0; const c = new RatesClient({ fetchRate: async () => { calls += 1; return calls * 10; }, now: () => t }); await c.getRate(`usd`, `eur`); t = 3600000; const r = await c.getRate(`usd`, `eur`); if (calls !== 1 || r !== 10) { console.error(`refetched after ttl`); process.exit(1); } console.log(`cached rate returned one hour after it was stored`);'
selfChecks.why: proves the grader-only fact: with the default ttlSeconds (300), a cached rate is still returned an hour after it was stored, so the source does not enforce the lifetime the scope wants documented as guaranteed

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): a small dependency-free Node ESM library, rates-client, with RatesClient (src/client.js) wrapping a caller-supplied fetchRate in RateCache (src/cache.js). RateCache.get() never checks age; prune() applies ttlSeconds only when set() pushes size over maxEntries. README calls ttlSeconds the 'cache lifetime'. Tests (6) cover storage, overflow pruning, eviction, per-pair caching, case normalization, clearCache; none covers expiry on read. 50-cycle: DOCUMENTATION cycle started in AUDITING with INITIAL handoff and a Request recording the standalone Documenter entry. 51-context: Auditor CONTEXT.md (accurate, no enforcement claim) and STATE at SCOPING (FORWARD from AUDITING). 52-scope: SCOPE record with AC-001..AC-004 (AC-002 states the guarantee plainly) and final STATE at ARCHITECTING, FORWARD from SCOPING, CompletionPolicy NONE, Architecture/Development NONE, BlockedOn NONE, recovery inactive. The utterance is the catalog's bare 'Continue.'; the finding and its classification are left for the role to reach from source.
